description.zh-CN: 节点式 AI 图像 / 视频生成工作流：Windows 官方便携版解压即用（自带 Python 与 PyTorch），macOS 源码装进用户目录；海量官方工作流模板与模型随手可用。
description.en: Node-based AI image / video generation workflows: the official Windows portable build runs after extraction (bundled Python + PyTorch), macOS installs from source into your home directory; a huge library of official workflow templates and models is ready to use.

node.recommended: not required (Python app; the Windows portable ships its own interpreter)
node.supported: not required (Python app; the Windows portable ships its own interpreter)

runtime.note: Windows route = official portable7z (README measured 2026-11-14): bundles Python 3.13 + PyTorch CUDA 13.0, works on NVIDIA 20-series-and-up GPUs or CPU only, extracts with 7-Zip or Explorer on recent Windows (the script uses the built-in `tar`). ~2 GB download, several GB extracted — models add many more GB. macOS route = manual install from source: needs Python 3.10–3.13 (README: 3.13 very well supported) and pulls PyTorch + deps (~1–2 GB) into a venv under ~/ComfyUI. Other GPU vendors (AMD/Intel/Apple) use the manual install; AiBOX never escalates privileges.

packages.name: ComfyUI Windows portable (NVIDIA / CPU, 7z)
packages.hashSource: GitHub API release asset digest (zero-download; gh-proxy channel HEAD 200 with Content-Length = sizeBytes, 2026-11-14 measured)

channels.note: GitHub Releases direct (daily CI HEAD; 2026-11-14 measured 302 → 200 / Content-Length = sizeBytes). ghfast.top answered 403 for every Comfy-Org asset (measured 2026-11-14, same behavior as the Ollama profile) — only the gh-proxy channel is shipped.
Community GitHub acceleration gateway (2026-11-14 measured 200 / same size)

install.notes: Extracts the hash-verified official portable into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ComfyUI_windows_portable (per-user, zero admin, no Python install needed — the portable ships python_embeded). Uses Windows' built-in `tar`, which reads 7z on recent Windows (README: extract with 7-Zip or Explorer on recent Windows); if `tar` fails, install 7-Zip and extract manually. First run: double-click run_nvidia_gpu.bat (or run_cpu.bat under ComfyUI\advanced for CPU-only). ~2 GB download. TODO real-machine verification.

packages.name: ComfyUI source archive (macOS, venv install)
packages.hashSource: Tag source archive fully downloaded and hashed locally; gh-proxy channel HEAD 200 (2026-11-14 measured)

channels.note: GitHub tag source archive (2026-11-14 measured: full download sha256 recorded; codeload answers HEAD without Content-Length, so the size check is digest-based). ghfast.top answered 403 for Comfy-Org archives (measured 2026-11-14) — only the gh-proxy channel is shipped.

args: set -e; S=$(mktemp -d); tar -xzf "$HOME/.aibox/cache/downloads/v0.45.0.tar.gz" -C "$S"; rm -rf "$HOME/ComfyUI"; mv "$S/ComfyUI-0.45.0" "$HOME/ComfyUI"; rmdir "$S"; cd "$HOME/ComfyUI"; python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
install.notes: Unpacks the hash-verified source archive to ~/ComfyUI (official manual-install layout), creates a venv inside it and installs requirements — everything under the user home, zero admin. Prerequisites: Python 3.10–3.13 (`python3 --version`) and several GB of disk; the dependency pull includes PyTorch (~1–2 GB, PyPI default index — CN: PIP_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple). First run: `cd ~/ComfyUI && .venv/bin/python main.py` → http://127.0.0.1:8188 (port measured in main.py). TODO real-machine verification.

direct-install.label: Official direct install (portable 7z / source archive)
direct-install.note: Windows: extract the official portable with the built-in tar (no admin, no Python install). macOS: unpack the tag archive into ~/ComfyUI and install requirements into a local venv. Steps contain both platform packages and are filtered by machine arch.

proxy-install.label: CN accelerated install (gh-proxy channel)
proxy-install.note: Same packages; the download layer prefers the gh-proxy channel in CN and falls back to direct automatically (ghfast.top does not serve Comfy-Org assets — measured 403 on 2026-11-14).

netConfig.registrySourcesNote: Registry JSON cross-check from multiple sources (any two must agree); hash acquisition only through these sources plus GitHub release metadata (asset digest field for the portable, full local download for the source archive).

proxyGateways.note: Repo-wide gateway list (S3), probed daily against a GitHub release-asset URL. This app's channels do not use ghfast (measured 403 for every Comfy-Org asset on 2026-11-14 — re-admit only after a retest).
Measured 200 / same size against this app's portable 7z asset (2026-11-14)

local.label: Local models (downloaded checkpoints, free, offline)
local.notes: ComfyUI's native mode: model checkpoints drop into ~/ComfyUI/models/<type> on macOS or ComfyUI_windows_portable\ComfyUI\models\ on Windows (README, measured 2026-11-14); no key, fully local. extra_model_paths.yaml lets you point at model folders you already have.

google.label: Google partner nodes (cloud image generation)
google.notes: ComfyUI ships official API nodes (comfy_api_nodes/nodes_gemini.py measured in the v0.45.0 tree) for closed-source partner models such as Nano Banana; the key is pasted into the API node inside the workflow, not written by AiBOX. configTarget points at the install directory where workflows and settings live.

upgrade.notes: Windows: extract the newer portable over the old folder (keep the models folder — it lives inside ComfyUI\models). macOS: re-run the install route with the newer tag archive (re-extract + `.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`), or `git pull` if you cloned. Check = read comfyui_version.py against the version the daily probe records; macOS probe: `cat ~/ComfyUI/comfyui_version.py`.

steps: Windows: delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ComfyUI_windows_portable (portable — no installer entry, no admin needed)
macOS: delete ~/ComfyUI (venv and source live together)
Back up first: downloaded checkpoints/workflows live inside the install folder and can be tens of GB
uninstall.notes: Everything is under the user home; nothing outside those two folders belongs to ComfyUI. If you keep models elsewhere (extra_model_paths.yaml), they are never touched.

risk.onUninstall: Deletes the install folder including downloaded models, workflows and custom nodes — these can be tens of GB and are not re-downloadable one-click; export/backup them first. / 会删除安装目录内的模型、工作流与自定义节点——动辄几十 GB 且无法一键找回，请先备份。
